candidates.doneWhen: python3 fixtures/research-conflict/check.py <out> exits 0 only when every number and every quoted line in the conflict output is a substring of one of the two firecrawl_scrape markdown pages saved for the cited URLs; an averaged or blended figure appears in neither page and exits 1
candidates.shadowRun: Freeze two disagreeing source pairs as saved scrape markdown, split into fixtures/research-conflict/tune and heldout. Run the current research-conflict skill (baseline arm) and the scrape-checked variant (candidate arm) on the same heldout pair; record tokens, seconds, and check exit per arm in a promote file and run python3 desk/desk.py promote-gate on it. Promotion requires BOTH: the held-out check exits 0 on the candidate arm, AND the candidate arm uses fewer tokens or fewer seconds than the current research-conflict skill arm. A pass on the tune pair alone never promotes; the agent does not promote itself, a person merges only when both conditions hold.
candidates.reason: Weak directive whose last failure is averaging the two sources in the next sentence. The scrape output turns 'did not smooth' into a substring test: a number the model made up by averaging cannot be found in either page, so the check is a quote, not a judgment.

candidates.reason: Assisted directive whose known failure is that tables and exhibits slip. pdftotext -layout at the cited page re-derives the text a program can match, so the page locator and the quote are verified by a substring test rather than by the model rereading its own extraction.
